body.name: WLGS
body.def: \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{LGS}}^{(5)}\) contains the model pairs certified by the failure construction of Theorem 5 of Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser (2024), with exactly the equality and target-disagreement obligations stated there; exact support \(H\), positivity of every cell in \(\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^{+})\), and equality of the single full joint table \(O_H\) are not added to this definition.
